subject: Execution request: BrightRiver MAP, tiered pricing & exec approval
messages:
From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@brightriver.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal & evaluation timeline

Kimberly — thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Eva (procurement) and I reviewed the MAP draft and we like the structure, but we need a commercial concession to move forward quickly. Key ask: a 30% introductory discount on hosted inference unit pricing for the first 12 months, tied to the MAP milestones below.

Overview (BrightRiver ask):
- 3-month evaluation (PoC) with success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 400ms for 90% of traffic; 95% parity on quality metrics vs incumbent.
- Commit: $500k ARR-equivalent commit within 12 months (monthly ramp targets in MAP).
- Ramp: 50% of traffic on Redwood by month 6, 80% by month 12.
- Pricing: 30% discount for months 0–12 on listed unit rates; revert to list price with possible volume bands thereafter.

Procurement note: They need exec-level approval for discounts >=25% and a legal sign-off window of 5 business days. They can sign within 48–72 hours if we confirm discount and SOW. Attached our internal procurement checklist (BR_MAP_v1.pdf).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can authorize 30% now or if we need escalation (VP/CFO/CEO)? If escalation is required, please advise what evidence/commits you need (signed LOI, prepayment, guaranteed minimums).

Tom
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightRiver, Inc.

Subject: Fwd: BrightRiver - MAP discount ask — need approval chain

Forwarding Tom's note — BrightRiver is asking for a 30% introductory discount tied to the MAP milestones. They will sign quickly if we give the concession and clean up the SOW.

Quick context and recommended commercial response (my take):
- We should offer a phased plan: 20% immediate discount + an additional 10% uplift (to 30%) contingent on meeting clearly defined MAP ramps and a firm commit (preferred: $600k over 12 months or $500k plus 3-month prepay).
- Trade-offs to request: LOI or minimal prepaid tranche, stricter early-termination fees, and executive sponsor on their side.

Requests from this thread:
- Marcus: margin / finance impact (break-even) and whether Finance can approve up to X% without CEO sign-off.
- Laura: route for VP/CEO approval; prefer to minimize exec involvement if possible but we should be ready to escalate.
- Ben: negotiation approach + proposed MAP milestones and gating language.
- Vivek & Evelyn: support capacity and SOW changes needed for onboarding / onboarding SLOs.

Attachments I’m including: draft SOW support hours workbook (SOW-support-hours.xlsx) and my inline redlines.

I need a short reply (one line approvals or concerns) by EOD so I can respond to Tom before they escalate to other vendors.

Thanks — Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-03-20T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightRiver - MAP discount ask — need approval chain

Kimberly — on my side I support a conditional approach:
- Commercial proposal: 20% standard discount to close quickly; cascade to 30% if they hit the mapped milestones (explicit ramp targets and LOI).
- Must secure at least a $400k minimum commit or 3-month prepayment for us to give 25% upfront; 30% only if they commit to $600k+ or we get a signed LOI and evidence of partner exec sponsor.

Suggested MAP milestone snippet (to share with Tom):
1) Week 0–12 (Evaluation): enablement, PoC, performance validation. Success: latency and quality SLOs met; Redwood supplies engineer support (x hours).
2) Month 3–6: partial production ramp to 50% traffic; billing at agreed volumes with 20–30% discount depending on prepay.
3) Month 6–12: ramp to 80% traffic; premium discount tier applies if committed ARR threshold hit.

Trade-offs / levers we should ask for: LOI, 30-day rolling prepayment window, or explicit business metrics we can track to flip discounts.

I’ll be the point with Tom to keep momentum. If Finance can approve up to 22–25% that lets us get a quick win; anything beyond that will need Marcus + Laura signoff.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRiver MAP - finance perspective

Quick finance read:
- 20% discount is broadly acceptable within our standard incentive bands; net margin stays positive given expected unit economics and caching/efficiencies.
- 25% is a stretch but doable with a minimum guarantee (recommendation: $400k committed ARR or 3 months prepay).
- 30% is material to gross margin and requires CEO approval. If we consider 30% we need: signed LOI that commits to $600k ARR-equivalent over 12 months OR a $350k prepayment + explicit ramp schedule tied into billing.

Break-even back-of-envelope: with a 30% discount, expected gross contribution on this deal would drop by ~18% vs list given their usage profile (KV cache assumptions included). That is allowable only as a strategic account with exec sponsorship and a clear retention clause (1-year minimum with early termination fee).

Please attach the final SOW with explicit hours and support tiers — I’ll run the exact numbers. If Ben can secure LOI or prepay, Finance can bless 25% immediately. Anything >25% needs formal escalation to Jonas.

Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRiver - approval recommendation (25% tactical / escalate for 30%)

Team — I agree with Marcus. Recommendation for go-live:
- Approve offering BrightRiver a 25% discount now if they sign a 12-month commitment of at least $400k OR provide a $300k prepayment. Include the MAP milestones Ben outlined and an executive sponsor clause.
- Escalate to Jonas for the additional 5% (to reach 30%) only if BrightRiver provides a signed LOI committing to $600k ARR-equivalent and a named C-level sponsor. This will require a 1:1 note from me to Jonas and legal to add an early-termination fee clause.

Next steps (who does what):
- Ben: confirm LOI possibility and push for prepayment.
- Kimberly: draft an email back to Tom with the 25% offer + conditions; call out that 30% is CEO-level escalation and what they would need to provide.
- Marcus: hold final finance numbers; I will prep a short note to Jonas if Ben secures LOI.
- Vivek & Evelyn: validate support capacity and confirm SOW hours in the attached workbook.

I’m approving the 25% as a tactical close to preserve momentum. Escalation to Jonas only if BrightRiver meets the LOI / commit threshold.

Laura Bennett
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRiver - CEO decision on 30% escalation

Laura / team — thanks for the summary. I’ll approve an exceptional 30% introductory discount but only under the following concrete conditions (no exceptions):
1) Signed commercial commitment: $600k ARR-equivalent over 12 months OR $350k prepayment + a contractual minimum of $400k.
2) MAP milestones explicitly codified with measurable SLOs for performance and ramp (the PoC success criteria and monthly traffic targets).
3) A named exec sponsor on BrightRiver’s side and a short LOI signed by their Head of Procurement / Head of Engineering.
4) Legal to add an early-termination fee that protects our minimum contribution if they fail to ramp.
5) If they miss the month-6 ramp target (50% traffic), we revert pricing to 20% discount until they recover.

If Ben can secure the LOI and we get the agreed SOW/DocuSign in the next 72 hours, Kimberly — you have authority to finalize the 30% concession and send the DocuSign link. Marcus: please prepare the final margin memo for records and Evelyn/Vivek please finalize support-hour commitments so legal can attach to the SOW.

Jonas Weber
CEO, Redwood Inference
